topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Hey, I just found out about the whole condo thing. Guess things are changing, huh? It’s a big shift, but we’ll figure it out. I’ve been thinking, maybe it’s not all bad. Could be a chance to shake things up, meet some new folks, and who knows, maybe find a place that’s even more you. We’ve weathered bigger storms. Whatever comes next, we’ll handle it together. Let’s grab coffee and talk more about it, yeah? No rush, just whenever you’re ready.
